exposure: women with two or more psychological distress conditions
pacifier use within the first 2 weeks postpartum
cohort: 542 women who gave birth in the hospital G.B. Grassi in Rome
finding: Planned cesarean delivery, experiencing two or more psychological distress factors, and early pacifier use were independently associated with shorter exclusive breastfeeding duration.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean delivery was associated with an increased odds of stopping exclusive breastfeeding before 4 months (OR 2.40, 95 % CI 1.06-5.43).
